- **`competitive-analyst`**: Monthly feature-gap report against the competitors named in config, built from their public pages, changelogs and pricing, with every claim cited and dated. Web content is untrusted.
- **`customer-feedback-synthesiser`**: Clusters support tickets, reviews and feedback into themes with counts, representative quotes and affected segments, then files the top themes as proposals for Product Owner intake. Requires: `product-owner`.
- **`estimator-planner`**: Breaks an approved epic into agent-sized tickets with S/M/L estimates, an explicit dependency graph (After: #N lines) and a sprint plan that respects the WIP limit. Requires: `product-owner`.
- **`pricing-analyst`**: On request, proposes a pricing or packaging experiment with a hypothesis, the metric it moves, guardrails, sample-size estimate and rollback, from revenue, usage and competitor data. Proposal only; humans decide prices.
- **`product-owner`**: Shapes every new issue and reply: classifies it as SHAPED or NEEDS SHAPING, posts a proposal with a ticket plan, requests team input, and cuts tickets once an approver agrees. Ends every intake with exactly one verdict. Requires: `team-thread-assessor`.
- **`requirements-analyst`**: Turns a SHAPED ticket of size M or larger into a spec at docs/specs/<n>.md: user stories, Gherkin acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements and open questions, so the Engineer and QA build and test the same thing. Requires: `product-owner`, `security-requirements`.
- **`roadmap-okr-planner`**: Once a quarter, drafts next quarter's OKRs and a now/next/later roadmap from last quarter's OKR progress, delivery data, feedback themes and debt. Drafts only: the owner sets objectives. The OKR Tracker measures them. Requires: `okr-tracker`.
- **`security-requirements`**: Picks the OWASP ASVS level (L1/L2/L3) for a ticket from the data and capabilities it touches, and writes the security NFRs and abuse cases that every size M+ spec must carry.
- **`team-thread-assessor`**: Short, parallel department assessments (Architect, Engineer, and Legal, Finance, Growth or Security when in scope) of a Product Owner proposal. Each ends with "blocking: yes\|no"; the PO turns them into consensus or dissent.

- **`accessibility-designer`**: For a UI change (proposal, UX spec or PR), produces a WCAG 2.2 AA checklist tailored to the change and flags design-level barriers before build.
- **`api-contract-designer`**: For a new or changed endpoint, drafts or updates the OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract, runs an oasdiff breaking-change check against the base branch and reports the diff with a versioning recommendation. Requires: `reviewer`.
- **`architect`**: Turns a ticket labelled needs-design into ADRs and a design doc on a design PR (Gate-for: #<n>); implementation waits until the design merges.
- **`architect-quarterly`**: Quarterly read of ADRs, module boundaries and threat models that reports architecture drift, top risks and concrete ADR proposals as one finding. Requires: `architect`.
- **`cloud-architect`**: For an infrastructure proposal, writes a cloud architecture doc with a diagram, environment and network layout, resilience targets and a monthly cost estimate with stated assumptions. Requires: `architect`, `iac-devops-engineer`, `threat-modeler`.
- **`data-migration-planner`**: For a proposed schema change, writes a reversible expand/contract migration plan with backfill, verification and rollback steps, and forces risk:high. Requires: `architect`.
- **`security-architect-assessor`**: Joins the team-thread when a Product Owner proposal touches auth, crypto, PII or payments and posts a short assessment ending in a blocking verdict. Requires: `team-thread-assessor`, `threat-modeler`.
- **`threat-modeler`**: Builds a STRIDE + LINDDUN + OWASP LLM Top 10 threat model for a design or security-sensitive ticket, writes docs/threats/<n>.md and opens one mitigation ticket per unmitigated high or critical threat. Requires: `architect`.
- **`ux-designer`**: For a user-facing proposal, writes a wireframe spec (flows, screens, states, copy), maps it to existing design tokens and links a Figma or Stitch frame when the project has one. Requires: `product-owner`, `accessibility-designer`.

- **`data-engineer`**: Builds and changes data pipelines (dbt models, Airflow/Dagster DAGs and similar) with data-quality tests, lineage notes and backfill plans. Requires: `engineer`.
- **`database-migration-engineer`**: Writes schema and data migrations with tested down-migrations using the expand/contract pattern, batches backfills, and always labels the PR risk:high for human merge. Requires: `engineer`, `data-migration-planner`.
- **`documentation-writer`**: After a user-facing PR merges, updates the user docs and the changelog's Unreleased section in a follow-up docs PR, citing the merged PR. Requires: `engineer`.
- **`engineer`**: Implements a shaped ticket on a branch, with tests, and opens a PR that closes the issue. Language-neutral core prompt; stack rules come from packs. Requires: `product-owner`.
- **`frontend-engineer`**: Implements UI tickets through the project's component library: reusable components with stories, accessibility, and visual-regression baselines, opened as a PR that closes the ticket. Requires: `engineer`.
- **`iac-devops-engineer`**: Writes Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi or Helm changes as PRs, posts the plan output as a PR comment and flags destructive changes. Apply is human-only. Requires: `engineer`, `iac-scanner-triage`.
- **`integration-engineer`**: Builds third-party API and webhook integrations with contract tests, signature verification, idempotency, retries with backoff and secrets read from configuration only. Requires: `engineer`.
- **`localisation`**: Extracts hard-coded user-facing strings into the i18n catalogue and opens translation PRs for configured locales, marking machine translations for review and never auto-translating legal or regulated text. Requires: `engineer`.
- **`mention`**: Answers an approver's "@squad" mention on an issue or PR: explains, fixes code on the PR branch, rebases or resolves conflicts. Never merges. Requires: `engineer`.
- **`ml-engineer`**: Builds reproducible model training and evaluation pipelines, with pinned data/versions, evaluation against a baseline and a model card. Never promotes a model to production. Requires: `engineer`.
- **`review-fix`**: Addresses a Reviewer's REQUEST CHANGES on an agent PR in capped fix rounds (default 2), replying per comment, pushing verified fixes, and handing a decision digest to approvers when the cap is reached. Requires: `engineer`, `reviewer`.

- **`accessibility-tester`**: Runs axe-core and pa11y against the preview deployment, triages violations against WCAG 2.2 AA, and fails the a11y gate on new serious or critical violations introduced by the PR. Requires: `accessibility-designer`.
- **`dast-triage`**: Triages OWASP ZAP baseline scan findings from preview or staging, separates real issues from false positives with a written justification, and opens deduplicated tickets mapped to CWE and ASVS.
- **`dependency-steward`**: SCA on every manifest/lockfile change (OSV-Scanner) plus a weekly pass that groups Dependabot/Renovate updates into reviewable upgrade PRs and flags end-of-life runtimes. Feeds the gate:sca check.
- **`iac-scanner-triage`**: Triages Checkov, Trivy (config + image) and hadolint results on PRs that change IaC, Kubernetes manifests or Dockerfiles; explains each failed check, proposes the exact fix and keeps high/critical misconfigurations blocking.
- **`license-compliance`**: Checks licences of new and changed dependencies (and vendored code) with ScanCode/licensee against the allowlist policy in config; blocks denied licences and routes unknown or conditional ones to an approver.
- **`mutation-flaky-analyst`**: Weekly report on test-suite health: mutation score from the configured mutation tool, the flakiest tests from CI retry history, and up to five targeted tickets to quarantine, fix or strengthen tests.
- **`pentest-assistant`**: Supports an authorised, human-led penetration test before a release: checks the signed scope file, drafts a test plan mapped to OWASP WSTG and the threat model, and turns tester notes and tool output into a pre-release report. Refuses anything out of scope or outside the test window. Requires: `threat-modeler`.
- **`performance-tester`**: Runs Lighthouse (web vitals) and k6 (API load) against the preview or staging environment, compares results with the budgets in docs/perf/budgets.yml, and fails the perf gate on budget breaches.
- **`preview-qa`**: Deterministic Playwright smoke test against a successful preview deployment (deployment_status event); posts a pass/fail comment with the preview URL. No model involved. Skips when no frontend files changed or no e2e suite exists.
- **`qa-test-planner`**: Writes a risk-based test plan per feature (docs/test-plans/<n>.md) mapped to the acceptance criteria, then runs an exploratory session against the preview deployment and reports defects as tickets. Requires: `requirements-analyst`.
- **`reviewer`**: Reviews every agent or human PR for correctness, product quality and policy; posts inline comments plus exactly one verdict and a risk label that the merge policy uses as its gate.
- **`sast-triage`**: Triages CodeQL/Semgrep SARIF on a PR: confirms true positives with a fix suggestion, proposes false-positive dismissals with written justification, and never clears a high/critical alert on its own. Feeds the gate:sast check.
- **`secrets-response`**: Responds to a gitleaks finding or a push-protection bypass with a rotation runbook: revoke first, rotate, purge-history guidance and audit-log review. Never echoes the secret. Feeds the gate:secrets check.
- **`security-reviewer`**: Independent security review on a different model/provider from the Reviewer. Required for auto-merge and for every PR with risk >= medium; labels the PR security:approved or security:review-required with findings mapped to CWE and OWASP ASVS 4.0. Requires: `reviewer`.
- **`visual-regression`**: Compares screenshots of the preview deployment against the baseline from the default branch, classifies each diff as intended, regression or noise, and posts a check result with the diff gallery. Requires: `preview-qa`.

## Release

| Skill | Tier | Default | Trigger | Tools | Model | Outputs | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Change Manager**<br>`change-manager` | enterprise | off | event deployment.created (environment == production)<br>command @squad change-record | comment | light | `docs/changes/{change_id}.md`, comment, label `awaiting-approval`, `needs-human`, `blocking` | blocks on `awaiting-approval` |
| **Deploy Orchestrator**<br>`deploy-orchestrator` | pro | off | event release.published<br>command @squad deploy | comment | light | comment, json, label `awaiting-approval`, `needs-human` | blocks on `awaiting-approval` |
| **Mobile Release (internal tracks only)**<br>`mobile-release` | core | off | command @squad mobile-release<br>event release.published (project has a mobile pack (react-native, flutter, swift-ios, kotlin-android)) | edit-test-push | light | pr, json, comment |  |
| **Release Manager**<br>`release-manager` | core | on | command @squad release<br>schedule release_train | edit-test-push | heavy | pr, `docs/releases/v{version}.md`, comment | check `squadhq/release-readiness` |
| **SBOM and Provenance**<br>`sbom-provenance` | core | on | event workflow_run.completed (workflow == release-build)<br>command @squad verify-release | comment | light | check, comment | check `squadhq/supply-chain` |

- **`change-manager`**: Drafts a change record for each production deploy (risk, impact, test evidence, rollback, schedule), checks it against freeze windows and the CAB-lite policy, and syncs it to ServiceNow or a tracker issue. Approval stays with the named approvers. Requires: `release-manager`.
- **`deploy-orchestrator`**: Plans a deployment through the configured adapter (Vercel, Railway, Fly, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP): canary steps, health signals, feature-flag states and abort criteria. Requests the deploy through the environment approval; deterministic code executes it. Never triggers production itself. Requires: `release-manager`.
- **`mobile-release`**: Prepares mobile builds for TestFlight and the Google Play internal track: version and build numbers, release notes, store metadata diffs and a Fastlane lane request. Never submits to production review and never touches signing keys. Store metadata automation is a Pro feature. Requires: `release-manager`.
- **`release-manager`**: Prepares a release: computes the next semver from conventional commits since the last tag, writes the changelog and release notes, and a rollback plan. Opens a release PR; tagging and publishing are done by code after a human approves. Requires: `sbom-provenance`.
- **`sbom-provenance`**: Verifies the supply-chain evidence that deterministic CI produced for a release: CycloneDX SBOM, SLSA provenance and cosign signatures. Reports missing or mismatched attestations and fails the release gate until they are fixed.

| **Observability Engineer**<br>`observability-engineer` | pro | off | command @squad observability<br>event pull_request.opened (adds a new service, endpoint or queue consumer (detected by pack paths)) | edit-test-push | heavy | comment, pr, `observability/{service}/` |  |
| **Postmortem Writer**<br>`postmortem-writer` | pro | off | event issues.closed (labels contains incident)<br>command @squad postmortem | edit-test-push | heavy | `docs/postmortems/{date}-{slug}.md`, pr, issue, comment |  |
| **Rollback**<br>`rollback` | core | on | command @squad rollback | edit-test-push | light | pr, comment, label `needs-human`, `risk:high` | blocks on `needs-human` |
| **SRE / Incident Responder**<br>`sre-incident-responder` | pro | off | label incident<br>event issues.opened (labels contains incident (opened by uptime-watcher or an alert webhook))<br>command @squad incident | edit-test-push | heavy | comment, `docs/incidents/{issue}-timeline.md`, pr, label `escalation`, `needs-human` | blocks on `needs-human` |
| **Stuck Sweeper** ★<br>`stuck-sweeper` | core | on | schedule stuck_sweeper<br>manual | comment | none | label `agent:shape`, `agent:continue`, `agent:implement`, `escalation`, report |  |
| **Uptime Watcher**<br>`uptime-watcher` | core | on | schedule uptime_watch | comment | none | issue, label `P0`, `incident`, comment |  |

- **`backend-debt`**: Weekly tech-debt scan of the backend pack roots: clusters outdated dependencies, boundary violations, coverage hotspots, duplication and suppressed warnings into deduplicated debt findings.
- **`board-sync`**: Deterministic sync of ticket state to the project board (todo, in_progress, in_review, done); discover, single-ticket sync and backfill modes.
- **`finance`**: Weekly LLM and agent spend report from usage.json and the cost ledger: month-to-date pace vs budget, top jobs by cost, cost anomalies with transcript links, review spend avoided.
- **`finops`**: Weekly cloud-bill analysis: spend by service and environment, anomalies against a trailing baseline, idle and oversized resources, and rightsizing or commitment proposals with estimated savings. Proposes tickets; never changes infrastructure. Requires: `finance`.
- **`frontend-debt`**: Weekly tech-debt scan of the frontend pack roots: clusters outdated dependencies, boundary violations, coverage hotspots, duplication and suppressed warnings into deduplicated debt findings.
- **`hub-janitor`**: Deterministic daily cleanup of the hub repo: closes superseded report issues and stale automation PRs, merges safe housekeeping PRs. Supports a dry-run mode that only reports.
- **`observability-engineer`**: Reviews a feature or service for logging, metrics and tracing coverage against an SLO-driven checklist, and opens a PR with instrumentation plus dashboards and alerts as code.
- **`postmortem-writer`**: Writes a blameless postmortem from a resolved incident's timeline, thread and linked PRs into docs/postmortems/<date>-<slug>.md, and proposes action items as tickets. Requires: `sre-incident-responder`.
- **`rollback`**: On `@squad rollback #<pr>` from an approver, prepares a revert PR for a named merged PR after checking for migrations, data changes, external side effects and later dependent PRs. A human reviews and merges; the agent never merges or deploys. Requires: `reviewer`.
- **`sre-incident-responder`**: Turns an alert or uptime incident into a managed incident: severity, impact statement, timestamped timeline, suspect-PR bisect over recent deploys, and a revert PR that a human must approve and merge. Requires: `uptime-watcher`, `rollback`.
- **`stuck-sweeper`**: Deterministic hygiene: finds tickets stuck past the thresholds in flood-guards.stuck_sweeper (unshaped, dispatched but idle, review stalled) and re-applies the dispatch label or escalates.
- **`uptime-watcher`**: Deterministic health checks against configured URLs. After failure_threshold consecutive failures it opens one P0 incident issue (labels P0 + incident) and pings the escalation channel; after recovery_threshold consecutive successes it comments the recovery and auto-closes the issue. No model is involved.

- **`analytics-reporter`**: Weekly product metrics report from PostHog, GA4 or Mixpanel exports compared against the current OKRs: trend, anomalies, data-quality caveats. Aggregates only, no personal data in the output. Requires: `okr-tracker`.
- **`chief-of-staff`**: Keeps every project board coherent: WIP limits, stalled work, debt share, resurfacing and escalations, every 30-60 minutes.
- **`compliance-mapper`**: Maps evidence that already exists in the repos and tracker to SOC 2 TSC, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A, GDPR, HIPAA and PCI DSS 4.0 controls, writing docs/compliance/evidence-<framework>.md with "evidence found" or "gap" per control. Never asserts certification or compliance.
- **`daily-brief`**: One morning digest issue in the hub summarising open work, merges, spend and escalations. Digest only, never creates tickets.
- **`documentation-gardener`**: Weekly sweep of a repo's docs for broken links, stale citations, commands and config keys that no longer exist, and orphaned pages; fixes mechanical issues in one docs-only PR and files tickets for the rest.
- **`ecosystem-watch`**: Tracks provider, model, tooling and framework changes (releases, deprecations, pricing, incidents) and says what to do about them.
- **`growth`**: Nightly research of where target users talk, plus at most a few honest, self-reviewed content drafts filed as awaiting-approval tickets. Drafts only, never posts.
- **`legal`**: Weekly legal and compliance scan (privacy policy vs practice, consent, terms, claims, new regulation) for configured jurisdictions. Not a lawyer; every finding needs human confirmation.
- **`lessons-harvester`**: Weekly PR proposing cited additions to org/lessons.md from real escalations, verdicts and fixes. Every lesson cites a source; a human merges.
- **`okr-tracker`**: Measures progress against approver-written OKRs; edits only Progress and Evidence lines in org/strategy/okrs.md via a PR.
- **`privacy-dpia`**: When a change adds or alters personal data (schema, new processor, tracking), drafts a GDPR Art. 35-structured DPIA record at docs/privacy/dpia-<n>.md with a data map, and blocks the change until a human privacy owner signs it off. Not legal advice. Requires: `threat-modeler`.
- **`sales-engineer`**: Drafts answers to RFPs and security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, custom) from the company's own docs only. Every answer cites a source file or says "needs owner answer"; never invents certifications, controls or customers. Requires: `compliance-mapper`.
- **`seo`**: Weekly SEO report per project with small, costed proposals; clear wins become tickets. Drafts only.
- **`support-triage`**: Triages inbound support tickets (Zendesk, Intercom, email): dedupes against open issues, sets severity, routes bugs and feature requests into the tracker and drafts a holding reply for a human to send. Never promises dates or shares another customer's data. Requires: `product-owner`.
- **`weekly-rollup`**: Monday rollup issue across projects and department weeklies. Digest only, exactly one action.

## Platform (Agent Squad HQ itself)

| Skill | Tier | Default | Trigger | Tools | Model | Outputs | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Config Doctor**<br>`config-doctor` | core | on | command @squad doctor<br>manual | comment | light | comment, label `needs-human`, `escalation` |  |
| **Model Router Tuner**<br>`model-router-tuner` | core | off | schedule monthly_model_routing<br>command @squad tune-models | edit-test-push | light | pr, label `awaiting-approval` |  |
| **Onboarding Guide**<br>`onboarding-guide` | core | on | command @squad help<br>label question | comment | light | comment, label `needs-human`, `escalation` |  |
| **Prompt & Eval Engineer**<br>`prompt-eval-engineer` | core | off | command @squad improve-prompt<br>schedule weekly_prompt_eval | edit-test-push | heavy | pr, `evals/results/{timestamp}.json`, label `awaiting-approval` | check `squadhq/evals` |

- **`config-doctor`**: Explains `squadhq doctor` failures in plain language: what is wrong, why it matters, and the exact command or setting that fixes it. Reads redacted diagnostics only and never handles secret values.
- **`model-router-tuner`**: Monthly proposal for which model tier and provider each skill should use, from the cost ledger, run outcomes and eval scores. Opens a config PR with the expected saving and quality evidence; humans merge. Requires: `prompt-eval-engineer`.
- **`onboarding-guide`**: Answers "how do I…" questions about Agent Squad HQ from the shipped docs, inside the user's tracker, with links to the exact doc section. Says "not documented" rather than guessing.
- **`prompt-eval-engineer`**: Proposes a prompt change for one skill from failing evals, lessons and escalations, runs the eval suite before and after, and opens a PR with the score diff. Never weakens untrusted-input rules or authority limits.
